activity.notes: Saigō was not the ruler of Satsuma Domain. He rose as a Satsuma retainer under Shimazu Nariakira, later became one of the domain's principal military-political leaders, and helped lead the anti-shogunate coalition through the Meiji Restoration. ATLAS therefore uses active_in rather than rules.

sources.citation_text: The biography identifies Saigō as a Satsuma political figure who became a leading force in the movement that overthrew Tokugawa rule.

sources.title: Satsuma Domain
sources.citation_text: The domain history describes Saigō as a Satsuma retainer who led Satsuma forces and helped broker the Satsuma–Chōshū alignment against the shogunate.
